entity.name: Heshan Jayakody
entity.description: Maintainer of Mudal, a privacy-first SMS expense tracker for Sri Lanka and a fork of the PennyWise AI project.

projects.name: Mudal
projects.description: Mudal turns the transaction SMS that Sri Lankan banks already send into categorised, searchable financial records. Parsing, SQLCipher-encrypted storage, and budgets run entirely on the device: no account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking SDKs. Optional network features are exchange-rate lookup (open.er-api.com) and an opt-in AI chat assistant using your own Google Gemini API key. It is a fork of PennyWise AI (AGPL-3.0-only) focused on Sri Lankan banks, with no paywall and no feature limits.
